description: This file declares external API functions for the CCSP CWMP Stun Manager component, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions. It serves as an interface for other components to interact with the Stun Manager.

methods.name: CcspCwmpCreateStunManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new Stun Manager instance, given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: CcspCwmpStunmoCreate
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new CCSP CWMP Stun Manager object.

methods.name: CcspCwmpStunmoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Stun Manager object.

methods.name: CcspCwmpStunmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects associated with the Stun Manager.
